description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Yasuo''' thrusts his sword in a line in the target direction that deals physical damage to enemies hit and applies [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] and [[File:On-attack icon.svg|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Attacking|An icon representing the keyword On-attack]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Attacking|on-attack]] effects to the first enemy hit. ''Steel Tempest's'' damage based on its AD ratio can [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically strike]].
description.text: Active: Yasuo thrusts his sword in a line in the target direction that deals physical damage to enemies hit and applies on-hit and on-attack effects to the first enemy hit. Steel Tempest's damage based on its AD ratio can critically strike.

description2.raw: '''Steel Wind Rising:''' If this hits at least one enemy, '''Yasuo''' generates a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Gathering Storm'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 2 times and refreshing on subsequent hits. At 2 stacks, the next ''Steel Tempest'' cast consumes them all to become empowered with a new effect.
description2.text: Steel Wind Rising: If this hits at least one enemy, Yasuo generates a stack of Gathering Storm for 6 seconds, stacking up to 2 times and refreshing on subsequent hits. At 2 stacks, the next Steel Tempest cast consumes them all to become empowered with a new effect.

description3.raw: '''Gathering Storm Bonus:''' '''Yasuo''' unleashes a whirlwind in the target direction that applies and triggers the same effects and additionally [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knocks up]] enemies hit for 0.9 seconds.
description3.text: Gathering Storm Bonus: Yasuo unleashes a whirlwind in the target direction that applies and triggers the same effects and additionally knocks up enemies hit for 0.9 seconds.

description4.raw: ''Steel Tempest's'' thrust will fail to hit targets after the cast time if '''Yasuo''' was affected by [[File:Disarm icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Disarming|An icon representing the keyword Disarming crowd control]] [[:Crowd_control#Disarming|disarming crowd control]] during it, but the [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown of the ability is reset to 0.1 seconds.
description4.text: Steel Tempest's thrust will fail to hit targets after the cast time if Yasuo was affected by disarming crowd control during it, but the  cooldown of the ability is reset to 0.1 seconds.

description5.raw: If ''Steel Tempest'' is cast during ''[[File:Yasuo Sweeping Blade.png|20xpx|border|link=Yasuo#Sweeping Blade|An icon for Yasuo's ability Sweeping Blade]] [[Yasuo#Sweeping Blade|Sweeping Blade]]'', the cast is modified to cause '''Yasuo''' to slash around himself at the end of the dash, applying and triggering the same effects against nearby enemies. This slash can be empowered by ''Gathering Storm's'' bonus, causing it to additionally apply the [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knock up]] to enemies hit. ''Steel Tempest's'' cast time is not incurred when it is cast this way, but '''Yasuo''' will become [[File:Lockout icon 2.png|20px|link=Terminology#Lockout|An icon representing the keyword Lockout]] [[:Terminology#Lockout|unable]] to declare basic attacks for 0.5 seconds after the dash ends.
description5.text: If Steel Tempest is cast during Sweeping Blade, the cast is modified to cause Yasuo to slash around himself at the end of the dash, applying and triggering the same effects against nearby enemies. This slash can be empowered by Gathering Storm's bonus, causing it to additionally apply the knock up to enemies hit. Steel Tempest's cast time is not incurred when it is cast this way, but Yasuo will become unable to declare basic attacks for 0.5 seconds after the dash ends.

''Steel Tempest'' will still cast in this case. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] does not prevent a stack of ''Gathering Storm'' from being gained. * While at two stacks, a range indicator will be shown for the effective range of the whirlwind.
notes.text:
This ability always employs Quick cast.
Casting Sweeping Blade when Steel Tempest's remaining cooldown is less than 0.5 seconds resets this remaining cooldown to allow casting it in combination, but adds the refunded time to Steel Tempest's cooldown.
If Yasuo blinks during Sweeping Blade after having buffered Steel Tempest during it, he will perform the slash at the blink location, applying Steel Tempest's effects to enemies in the area at the time.
If Yasuo becomes unable to cast abilities during Sweeping Blade's dash after buffering Steel Tempest, Steel Tempest will not cast, but will still go on cooldown.(unexpected)
The whirlwind from consuming stacks of Gathering Storm can strike targets whose center is behind Yasuo, unlike most missiles.
Steel Tempest applies basic damage to the first (closest) enemy hit and area damage to secondary enemies:
* Steel Tempest will not apply spell effects to the first target hit, but will do so to the secondary ones.
* Spell vamp will only grant healing from the damage dealt to secondary targets, and healing is reduced to 33% effectiveness, accordingly.
*  Life steal will heal based on the damage dealt to the first target hit.
The whirlwind is a missile and can therefore be intercepted.
Steel Tempest will only draw minion aggro if the first target is a champion.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
Steel Tempest maintains its casting angle direction in relation to Yasuo if he moves during the cast time.
Each parry has different interactions with this ability, whether it's the first target of Steel Tempest or the secondary one. In either case Yasuo still gains a stack of Gathering Storm and his whirlwind knock-up cannot be negated by parries:
* Dodge: both first target and secondary target do not take damage.
* Block: first target does not take damage, secondary target does take damage.
* Blind: both first target and secondary target do take damage.
Steel Tempest rolls its critical strikes individually against each enemy hit.
Casting Last Breath during Steel Tempest will buffer it to cast after the cast time has completed.
* However, if Last Breath is used on a target affected by an airborne source that is not Yasuo, it is cast immediately due to Steel Tempest's cast time ending prematurely. Steel Tempest will still cast in this case.
Spell shield does not prevent a stack of Gathering Storm from being gained.
While at two stacks, a range indicator will be shown for the effective range of the whirlwind.

notes.text:
This ability always employs Quick cast.
Casting Sweeping Blade when Steel Tempest's remaining cooldown is less than 0.5 seconds resets this remaining cooldown to allow casting it in combination, but adds the refunded time to Steel Tempest's cooldown.
If Yasuo blinks during Sweeping Blade after having buffered Steel Tempest during it, he will perform the slash at the blink location, applying Steel Tempest's effects to enemies in the area at the time.
If Yasuo becomes unable to cast abilities during Sweeping Blade's dash after buffering Steel Tempest, Steel Tempest will not cast, but will still go on cooldown.(unexpected)
The whirlwind from consuming stacks of Gathering Storm can strike targets whose center is behind Yasuo, unlike most missiles.
Steel Tempest applies basic damage to the first (closest) enemy hit and area damage to secondary enemies:
* Steel Tempest will not apply spell effects to the first target hit, but will do so to the secondary ones.
* Spell vamp will only grant healing from the damage dealt to secondary targets, and healing is reduced to 33% effectiveness, accordingly.
*  Life steal will heal based on the damage dealt to the first target hit.
The whirlwind is a missile and can therefore be intercepted.
Steel Tempest will only draw minion aggro if the first target is a champion.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
Steel Tempest maintains its casting angle direction in relation to Yasuo if he moves during the cast time.
Each parry has different interactions with this ability, whether it's the first target of Steel Tempest or the secondary one. In either case Yasuo still gains a stack of Gathering Storm and his whirlwind knock-up cannot be negated by parries:
* Dodge: both first target and secondary target do not take damage.
* Block: first target does not take damage, secondary target does take damage.
* Blind: both first target and secondary target do take damage.
Steel Tempest rolls its critical strikes individually against each enemy hit.
Casting Last Breath during Steel Tempest will buffer it to cast after the cast time has completed.
* However, if Last Breath is used on a target affected by an airborne source that is not Yasuo, it is cast immediately due to Steel Tempest's cast time ending prematurely. Steel Tempest will still cast in this case.
Spell shield does not prevent a stack of Gathering Storm from being gained.
While at two stacks, a range indicator will be shown for the effective range of the whirlwind.
